subject: BrightBridge co-host webinar — promo code allocation request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: BrightBridge co-host webinar — promo code allocation request

Jasmine —

Following up from the partner meeting last week: BrightBridge wants a bulk allocation of access promo codes for the co-hosted webinar series (two sessions in September). Their ask is for 1,000 attendee promo codes (single-use, redeemable for a 30-day trial) to be delivered by Sep 1 so they can include redemption links in the attendee email.

Key asks for internal ops/accounting:
- Confirm cost center and unit cost for 1,000 trial redemptions (we have a partner discount applied per SOW).
- Generate the CSV of unique codes and mark 200 of them as VIP (speaker/partner staff) which may have different expiry rules — they requested longer validity if possible.
- Limit per-user redemptions to 1 code.

I've attached a short proposal with recommended expiry and tracking fields. If we can get approval from Jasmine + accounting by EOD Fri (8/28) we can meet BrightBridge's timeline.

Attachments: promo_codes_proposal.xlsx (Excel; contains cost calc and suggested code format)

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
443-555-0182
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightBridge co-host webinar — promo code allocation request

Marissa —

Thanks for the write-up. A few quick items before I sign off: 

- Confirm format: single-use alphanumeric, 12 chars, prefix BB-. OK?
- VIP set: we can make 200 VIP codes with a different flag. I prefer a longer expiry window (180 days) for VIPs — is BrightBridge okay with that?
- Trial configuration: Redwood will apply a 30-day trial entitlement on standard promo codes. VIP codes can be set to a speaker grant (no expiry) but that needs approval from finance due to cost capture differences.
- Per-user limit: enforce 1 redemption per email — set in the campaign config.

Ben — can you confirm the cost line and which cost center to charge for the 1,000 codes (partner promo budget vs marketing OEM)? Also flag if we need a separate GL for VIP grants. If finance needs a signed SOW before we generate codes, we should route to DocuSign.

If all looks good I will approve generation and have ops produce the CSV.

—Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com
From: Rachel Huang <rachel.huang@brightbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 08:20:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: BrightBridge co-host webinar — promo code allocation request

Hi Marissa / Jasmine —

Quick note from the BrightBridge ops side: we appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of asks from our end:

1) Can you reserve an additional 200 VIP speaker codes that do not expire (we'll use those for on-stage speakers and key partners)? They can be tagged VIP- in the CSV.
2) We need a column in the CSV for "campaign_source" so we can track which landing page each code comes from (we'll share the page ids).
3) If possible, please set the redemption domain to our partner landing page (we'll provide CNAME details next week).

We can sign whatever SOW is needed — I see you mentioned DocuSign. We need the codes by Sep 1 to include in speaker comms and the VIP outreach.

Best,
Rachel Huang
Sr. Partnerships Manager | BrightBridge Events
rachel.huang@brightbridge.com
+1 212-555-9023
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Huang <rachel.huang@brightbridge.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightBridge co-host webinar — promo code allocation request

Rachel —

All set. Finance and Ops coordinated and we can meet the Sep 1 deadline. Summary of final decisions: 

- Total codes: 1,200 (1,000 standard + 200 VIP speaker codes).
- Standard codes: prefix BB-, single-use, 12-char, 30-day trial entitlement, per-user limit = 1.
- VIP codes: prefix VIP-BB-, single-use, flagged as speaker grants; VIPs do NOT expire (requested by partner) but will be flagged in cost capture.
- CSV will include: code, prefix, campaign_source, validity_days (0 for no expiry), assigned_tag, notes.
- Redemption domain: we will set partner redirect/CNAME once Rachel provides DNS info (ops will coordinate).
- Cost center: Marketing Partnerships (GL: 710-PRT-BB). Ben confirmed.
- SOW/Approval: SOW sent for signature via DocuSign (link below). Codes will be generated after the SOW is signed for record-keeping.

Attachments: brightbridge_promo_codes_20260830.csv (CSV stub list of codes, 1,200 rows) ; SOW_BrightBridge_Webinar.docx (SOW text)

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/some-docusign-id-XY123
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bBrightBridgeSOW

If that matches your expectations, Rachel, I'll release the CSV and have Ops upload the codes into the campaign system once the SOW completes.

Thanks — looking forward to the series.

Marissa
